g.text: What multiple threshold regions look like in native profiles
C=20, f=1; first prespecified pilot path per model. Snapshot conditioning is diagnostic, not representative sampling.
WP selection: among its saved frames with >1 current half-contrast region, contrast ≥10% of basal, and R≥0.75, choose nearest the window midpoint.
Gory uses the same native time on its own independent path. The two models have separate native concentration scales; neither profile is peak-normalized.
The matched mean control receives the declared ensemble mean at every location. A low first moment or many threshold regions alone does not identify a mechanism.
Threshold arcs are morphology descriptors: they do not establish equal-strength peaks, functional competition, site lineage, or an event class.
